title: Evaluating the AI Potential as a Safety Net for Diagnosis: A Novel Benchmark of Large Language Models in Correcting Diagnostic Errors

live_model.evidence: 'Open AI (GPT-4o-2024-08-06, GPT-4.5-preview-2025-02-27, GPT-5-2025-08-07, GPT-o1-2024-12-17)' via API, 'temperature to 0.0 or the minimum possible value' (Methods)

prompt.location: Methods: 'Do you agree with the physician diagnosis? Yes, or No. If No, suggest the most likely diagnosis.' (zero-shot, new session per case)

claim.location: Table 1, row 8 'GTP-5 (HR)': 76/200 (38%) corrected, error detection 134 (67%); row 6 GPT-o1: 74/200 (37%)

data.source: 200 misdiagnosis vignettes (20 diseases x 10); 'Subset of the data is released as part of the benchmark in GitHub'; full data on request (Johns Hopkins policy)

notes: Responses were classified into agree/correct/incorrect categories by the authors (no automatic judge described); only a sample of cases is public.
